quiet_hours_rule: No Milovi Cake Telegram provider mutation may start outside the inclusive 09:00-21:00 local audience window. The gate must run before Telegram provider access and before durable dispatch intent is created.
missed_slot_rule: Do not catch up a missed post during quiet hours. Leave it pending for the next allowed slot.
manual_authorization_rule: A release or authorization created during quiet hours does not override this window unless a future separately reviewed emergency operation explicitly changes this policy.
